title: Berbamine improves behavioral impairments in Huntington's disease mice models through inhibiting Src/AKT1/NFkappaB signaling pathway and attenuating Src-mediated mitophagy suppression.
authors: Yuan, Chunling; Zheng, Li; Hu, Hongxia; Cheng, Xue; Liu, Peng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗胺改善亨廷顿病小鼠行为障碍的分子机制，聚焦Src/AKT1/NFkappaB信号通路和线粒体自噬，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Investigate the effects of berbamine (BBM) on alleviating motor and cognitive impairment in animal models of Huntington's disease (HD). METHODS: Intraperitoneal injection of 3-nitropropionic acid (3-NP) mice and B6-hHTT130-N transgenic mice were used as the HD models. We evaluated the anti-HD effect of BBM through behavioral experiments and employed molecular biological techniques, network pharmacology analysis, to test the potential mechanisms. RESULTS: BBM improved motor and cognitive impairment in 3-NP-injected and B6-hHTT130-N mice. BBM improved pathological damage in the brain, reduced the expression of mHTT in B6-hHTT130-N mice. BBM increased the ATP and mtDNA content, attenuated PINK1/Parkin-mediated mitophagy suppression. Furthermore, network pharmacology analysis, molecular docking and CETSA identified two targets: Src and AKT1. By using the Src inhibitor KX2-391, AKT inhibitor MK-2206 and NFkappaB inhibitor QNZ, we found that BBM showed a similar experimental results to Src inhibitor in Q74 plasmid transfected BV2 cells. BBM could inhibit the Src/AKT1/NFkappaB/NLRP3 signaling pathway-mediated neuroinflammation, and enhance PINK1/Parkin expression may through inhibiting Src. CONCLUSION: BBM ameliorates motor and cognitive impairments in HD model mice through inhibition of neuroinflammation and mHTT expression, maintenance of mitochondrial function, which was mediated by inhibiting Src/AKT1/NFkappaB signaling pathway and attenuating Src-mediated mitophagy suppression.
abstract_zh: 背景：研究小檗胺（berbamine, BBM）对亨廷顿病（Huntington's disease, HD）动物模型中运动及认知障碍缓解作用的影响。方法：采用腹腔注射3-硝基丙酸（3-nitropropionic acid, 3-NP）小鼠和B6-hHTT130-N转基因小鼠作为HD模型。通过行为学实验评估BBM的抗HD效果，并运用分子生物学技术、网络药理学分析来检测潜在机制。结果：BBM改善了3-NP注射和B6-hHTT130-N小鼠的运动及认知障碍。BBM改善了脑部病理损伤，降低了B6-hHTT130-N小鼠中mHTT的表达。BBM增加了ATP和mtDNA含量，减弱了PINK1/Parkin介导的线粒体自噬抑制。此外，网络药理学分析、分子对接和CETSA鉴定出两个靶点：Src和AKT1。通过使用Src抑制剂KX2-391、AKT抑制剂MK-2206和NFkappaB抑制剂QNZ，我们发现BBM在Q74质粒转染的BV2细胞中显示出与Src抑制剂相似的实验结果。BBM可抑制Src/AKT1/NFkappaB/NLRP3信号通路介导的神经炎症，并可能通过抑制Src增强PINK1/Parkin表达。结论：BBM通过抑制神经炎症和mHTT表达、维持线粒体功能，改善HD模型小鼠的运动及认知障碍，这一作用由抑制Src/AKT1/NFkappaB信号通路和减弱Src介导的线粒体自噬抑制所介导。
